page.layout: Running head across the top: "Scutum Regium." on the left, "LIB. III" on the right, with page number 120 at the far left. Below a rule, a decorative woodcut band (no text). Then the main text column: a title line in bold, LIBER III., CAP. I., and an italic heading in two lines. The narrow blank column at the left holds no text. No margin notes, no catchword, no signature.; One column of running text, left of centre, with a large woodcut initial at its start. No marginal notes, running head or page number visible. A short last line ends in a hyphenated word break ("Oc-").

main_text.head: Ab initio imperij Constantini, usque ad interitum Phocæ.
LIBER III.
CAP. I.
De fidelitate Hæreticorum & Paganorum in Constantinum, & Christianorum in Licinium.
main_text.p: Jam tandem hac perse-quutionum procella & caligine depulsa emicuit in Constantio Religionis quasi crepusculum : & in Constantino nostrate ad Christianismū plenè converso, quasi exorto supra Horizōtem Sole, effulsit plena radiatio : cum illo tamen discrimine ad verum Solem ; quod hu-[?]ius lumen progrediatur ab Oriente in Oc-

page.notes: Decorative woodcut band between the running head and the title; not text, not transcribed. The left margin column is blank. The right edge shows the start of the facing page, which is not part of this page and is not transcribed. The printed "L i b. I I I." of the running head is set in spaced capitals and is given as LIB. III. The woodcut initial I is joined to "am" as "Jam", following the rule for iam. The word "ius" at the start of the last full line is partly obscured by damage and is doubtful. No catchword, signature or page number is visible in this part.
